# @v10e/env

> 标签: cli, env, node, swc, typescript

## 简介

It provides a command line interface (CLI) for managing environment variables, settings and configurations for Node.js applications.

- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@v10e/env

- npm registry：https://registry.npmjs.org/@v10e/env
- Node 要求：>=16.0.0
